text:
maria: Heads-up — found a dead link in the runtime onboarding runbook (step 3 -> external S3 url 403). Can someone from docs own a quick patch? I'll volunteer to PR if owner points me to the file.

jamal: thanks for ping. which file path? I can take if it's under /runtime.

maria: it's in runtime-guide.md under docs/runtime/onboarding.md — link to s3://redwood-models/runtime-v2/weights -> 403. Snippet:
```
[download weights](https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/runtime-v2/weights)
```

olivia: @jamal I think this was added in the onboarding refresh last month. cc @docs-bot can you show last editor?

docs-bot: Edited by jamal on 2026-02-12 14:02 UTC (PR #712)

jamal: yep that was me. i swapped the s3 shortlink in the PR but it looks like the bucket policy changed. i'll open a quick PR to rehost on assets.redwood.ai. @maria — thanks for the offer, i'll assign and ping for review.

maria: perfect, thanks. small ask: can we also add a one-liner about the 2GB download size so users know it's large? quick sentence is fine.

ken_sre: fyi if you rehost on assets.redwood.ai make sure we add the presigned policy TTL note. better to use release artifacts if possible.

jamal: noted. will add TTL note.

olivia: quick check — do we need to update the runtime-onboarding checklist to include link-rot smoke test? maybe a note in the docs backlog.

maria: yes please. can we add an issue in the docs backlog? i'm swamped but can triage next sprint.

olivia: created issue #984 in docs backlog and linked PR when it's up. tag me for review.

jamal: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/820 — small sed replace + one-line size note + presigned TTL. assigning @olivia @maria for review.

maria: lgtm on content, leaving nit about wording. will approve after tiny tweak.

olivia: reviewed, approved. @jamal merge when green. :shipit: 

jamal: merged and deployed to staging. runtime onboarding preview: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/runtime/onboarding — checked the link; returns 200. will schedule a backfill to dedicated assets for long-term.

maria: awesome — thanks everyone. adding a quick follow-up to the onboarding guide to detect similar S3 shortlinks during CI.

docs-bot: Reminder: add AUTHORS or CODEOWNERS entries if you want ownership pinging for future changes.

maria: noted — i'll submit a tiny CODEOWNERS PR to include /docs/runtime/* -> @jamal.

jamal: thanks. done. PR #821.

olivia: outstanding example of async patching, thanks all.
